concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-management-latest-post-merchants-merchantid-payoutsettings]] — 2026-11-03-captured Management API v3 TEST request to add a merchant-account payout setting linked to a Legal Entity transfer instrument; Adyen bank verification determines `allowed`, while `enabled` and an optional effective date separately govern payout enablement. Configuration is not payout or bank-receipt proof.
